description: Removes the hardcoded tasks/reviews/<TASK-ID>.md path from the review-remediation-record capability's canonical text, referencing PROJECT_WORKFLOW.md's new canonical-locations declaration instead, so a project with different directory conventions can carry the exact canonical text and pass meridian audit without changing its real file layout.
delta: Replace the literal `tasks/reviews/<TASK-ID>.md` path in AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md's Review-remediation workflow section and docs/REVIEW_RECORD_TEMPLATE.md with a reference to the review-record location PROJECT_WORKFLOW.md declares (default unchanged: tasks/reviews/<TASK-ID>.md). Also adds the shared Canonical locations paragraph to PROJECT_WORKFLOW.md's Execution assets section. No behavioral change for a project that keeps the default locations.
verification: AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, and docs/REVIEW_RECORD_TEMPLATE.md carry a MERIDIAN:BEGIN capability=review-remediation-record v2 marker with no hardcoded tasks/reviews/<TASK-ID>.md path inside it
PROJECT_WORKFLOW.md's Execution assets section declares the project's canonical task/queue/review-record locations
A project that declares a different review-record location still carries byte-identical v2 protected text and passes meridian audit
